ground.formula: full harvested leaf mass + broken leaf mass

verdict: The two arms define Total (g) by different formulas over different underlying measurements: the flight value is a weighed subsample mean plus crew consumption, the ground value is a complete harvest plus broken-leaf mass. Only the ground arm records leaf counts. Pooling both into one target, with `flight` as a predictor, allows the model to fit a measurement-protocol difference rather than crop biology. The target is NOT a like-for-like comparison and must be reported as such.
header_defect: The published header declares three blank sub-headers for the MMD block while four replicate columns are populated, so key-based parsing shifts the labels from column 13 onward. Total (g) is unaffected; Consumption Avg. (g) and Return Samples (g) are mis-mapped.
